rows.name: V1_legal_all_generator
rows.note: Semantically legal: AND_k over 3 tokens; one term dead -> FAIL. Uses all(), no any().

rows.name: V2_legal_all_bound_list
rows.note: Legal: all() over a bound bool list, AND_k, no OR branch.

rows.name: V3_legal_all_renamed_vars
rows.note: Legal AND_k with deliberately non-tokenish names; tests name independence of LEGAL.

rows.name: V4_legal_any_with_all_and_attribution
rows.note: Legal: per-token attribution retained; any() present but k->vec not lost.

rows.name: V5_legal_any_over_samples
rows.note: Legal: existential over SAMPLES with ONE fixed literal (k=1).

rows.name: V6_legal_ok_accum_per_item_print
rows.note: Legal: ok &= is present, but per-token prints retain attribution.

rows.name: V7_true_collapse_renamed
rows.note: Genuine k->1bit: exists over 2 tokens, one aggregate PASS, no attribution. Names are deliberately non-tokenish (zzz/x/y), no keyword/word/needle.

rows.name: V8_true_collapse_no_any_keyword
rows.note: Genuine k->1bit with NO any() token at all: OR of bound bools via `or`. A semantic detector should catch it; a formal any()-screen cannot.

rows.name: V9_false_collapse_form_without_k
rows.note: any(GeneratorExp) form is present but k=1: semantically legal existence, no k->1bit loss. Tests whether formal shape alone triggers a report.

rows.name: V10_true_collapse_hits_variable_not_retained
rows.note: A variable NAMED hits is assigned a scalar 0 and never used; attribution is NOT actually retained. Semantically a genuine k->1bit defect.

rows.name: V11_true_collapse_min_argmin
rows.note: Genuine k->1bit via argmin: retains one scalar position, not which needle. No any() call.

rows.name: V12_legal_all_but_dead_input_invariant
rows.note: Independent all() negative control: AND_k cannot pass with input_1 dead.
